ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white and cream pixels dominate approximately 80% of the surface area, contrasted against a low-intensity black perimeter and median region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: White primary ground with a continuous black border; distinct yellowish-brown (diatom) pigmentation clusters located in the upper-central regions of both lobes; dark pigmentation extends from the peduncle through the median notch into the lower medial surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex; estimated angle of 60-70 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Relatively smooth continuous boundary with minor pixel-level irregularities; specific micro-indentations present on the medial trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a symmetrical concave curve from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edge/outer tips show a convex, upward-sweeping profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast circular clusters (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable barnacle colonization on the distal tips; small irregular notches on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive asymmetrical yellowish-brown bio-staining distributed in discrete patches across the mid-sections of both lobes.
